item.title: Fire rips through Philadelphia home on New Year's Eve leaving several hurt

item.title: Mummers Parade: Road closures, parking restrictions for New Year's Day celebration
item.description: Several road closures and parking restrictions are in place for the Mummers Parade in Philadelphia. Most of the traffic adjustments took effect overnight and won't end until the conclusion of the parade.The City of Philadelphia announced a slate of road closures and parking restrictions for the entirety of the Mummers Parade on New Year's Day. item.title: Car crashes into 'unsafe' house, ignites fire in Cheltenham: officials
item.description: A vehicle crash led to a fire at a house previously marked unsafe early Thursday morning. Chief Levy of the Elkins Park Fire Company arrived at 3:59 a.m. and reported the vehicle had struck a house at 808 Chelten Hills Dr., igniting both the vehicle and the front of the house. item.title: 2 Philly men wearing girdles charged after tequila heist in Bensalem
item.description: Bensalem Township Police have arrested two Philadelphia men after a series of retail thefts at the Fine Wine & Good Spirits store on Galloway Road. Officers responded to a theft on Dec. 10, 2025, where two suspects stole high-end tequila. The suspects used a dark green Toyota Tundra with New Jersey registration. item.title: 3-year-old boy shot inside West Philadelphia home: police
item.description: A young boy is recovering after a shooting incident inside his home in West Philadelphia. Police were called to the 900 block of North 42nd Street just before 5:00 p.m. after reports of a shooting. The incident occurred in a back bedroom where the boy lives with his father and his father's girlfriend. The child's father took him to the hospital, where he is reported to be in stable condition.
